description: This file defines configuration and implementation classes for an event generator streaming silo within an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes configuration options, a silo configurator, and the class for a time-bounded stream event generator.

classes.name: EventGeneratorStreamingSilo
classes.description: A silo configurator for setting up an event generator stream with configurable parameters and options.

classes.name: TimeBoundEventGeneratorConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for a time-bounded event generator stream.

classes.name: TimeBoundEventGenerator
classes.description: Implementation of an Orleans stream generator that produces events within a specified time window.

methods.name: EventGeneratorStreamingSilo.Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the silo configurator.

methods.name: EventGeneratorStreamingSilo.Options
methods.description: Provides a list of command-line options for configuring the silo.

methods.name: EventGeneratorStreamingSilo.Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo with stream generator options, storage, and publishing options based on provided parameters.

methods.name: TimeBoundEventGeneratorConfig.StreamGeneratorType
methods.description: Property indicating the type of stream generator.

methods.name: TimeBoundEventGenerator
methods.description: Handles generating stream events over a specified time interval, creating stream IDs and sequences.

methods.name: TimeBoundEventGenerator.Configure
methods.description: Initializes the generator with configuration parameters, stream IDs, and payload.

methods.name: TimeBoundEventGenerator.TryReadEvents
methods.description: Generates stream events if the current time is within the configured time window.
